courses.title: Complete HTML & CSS Bootcamp
courses.description: Learn HTML5 and CSS3 from the absolute basics and build a strong foundation in web development. Understand semantic HTML, forms, layouts, Flexbox and CSS Grid through practical examples. Build responsive websites that work smoothly across mobile, tablet and desktop devices. Complete real-world projects and develop the confidence to start your frontend development journey.

courses.title: Modern JavaScript Mastery
courses.description: Master modern JavaScript and understand how professional web applications work behind the scenes. Learn ES6+, functions, arrays, objects, DOM manipulation, events and asynchronous programming. Work with APIs, promises, async and await through practical projects. Build a strong JavaScript foundation that prepares you for React and modern frontend development.

courses.title: React JS Professional Course
courses.description: Learn React from the fundamentals and gradually move toward building professional web applications. Understand components, props, state, hooks, forms, React Router and API integration. Build reusable and scalable user interfaces using modern React development practices. Complete practical projects that help you become confident in real-world frontend development.

courses.title: Tailwind CSS & Modern UI
courses.description: Learn how to create modern and responsive websites using Tailwind CSS from beginner to advanced level. Understand utility classes, responsive breakpoints, layouts, typography, animations and reusable UI patterns. Build beautiful interfaces faster while maintaining clean and maintainable code. Create multiple real-world projects that can be added to your portfolio.

courses.title: Next.js Full Frontend Course
courses.description: Learn Next.js and understand how modern production-ready React applications are built. Explore App Router, layouts, server components, dynamic routes, data fetching and optimization techniques. Build fast and scalable applications with modern Next.js features and best practices. Finish practical projects that demonstrate your skills in real-world development.

courses.title: Node.js & Express Backend
courses.description: Build powerful backend applications using Node.js and Express with practical project-based learning. Learn server creation, routing, middleware, REST APIs, authentication and error handling. Connect your backend applications with databases and frontend applications. Build secure and scalable APIs that are useful for real-world full stack projects.

courses.title: REST API Development
courses.description: Learn how professional REST APIs are designed, developed and consumed by modern applications. Understand HTTP methods, status codes, routes, controllers, middleware and request validation. Build complete APIs with authentication, error handling and database integration. Test your APIs and learn practices used in production backend development.

courses.title: MongoDB & Database Design
courses.description: Learn MongoDB and understand how modern applications store and manage data using a NoSQL database. Explore collections, documents, queries, indexes, aggregation and database relationships. Connect MongoDB with Node.js applications and build practical database-driven projects. Develop the skills needed to work confidently with databases in full stack applications.

courses.title: PHP & Laravel Development
courses.description: Learn PHP and Laravel to build dynamic and professional web applications from scratch. Understand Laravel routing, controllers, models, migrations, authentication and database operations. Build complete applications using Laravel's powerful ecosystem and modern development practices. Work on real-world projects and develop practical backend development skills.

courses.title: MERN Stack Development
courses.description: Master the complete MERN stack and learn how to build modern full stack web applications. Work with MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js while connecting frontend and backend systems. Build authentication, REST APIs, database operations and complete user interfaces. Finish multiple real-world projects and prepare yourself for professional full stack development.

courses.title: Full Stack JavaScript
courses.description: Learn full stack JavaScript development by working with both frontend and backend technologies. Build responsive interfaces, create REST APIs and connect applications with databases. Understand authentication, application structure, Git and deployment workflows. Complete practical projects that help you understand how modern web applications are developed end to end.

courses.title: Next.js Full Stack Bootcamp
courses.description: Learn how to build complete full stack applications using Next.js and modern web technologies. Explore frontend development, API routes, server-side features, databases and authentication. Build fast, scalable and production-ready applications using practical development patterns. Create portfolio-worthy projects while learning professional full stack workflows.

courses.title: UI/UX Design with Figma
courses.description: Learn professional UI/UX design using Figma and understand the complete design process. Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, responsive layouts and reusable design systems. Learn typography, colors, spacing and visual hierarchy through practical design exercises. Build professional portfolio projects that demonstrate your UI/UX design skills.

courses.title: Professional Web Design
courses.description: Learn the fundamentals of professional web design and create visually attractive digital experiences. Understand layout, typography, color theory, spacing, visual hierarchy and responsive design principles. Practice designing modern websites for different industries and business needs. Build polished projects that can be presented in your design portfolio.

courses.title: Figma to Website Design
courses.description: Learn how to transform professional Figma designs into clean and responsive website layouts. Understand design handoff, spacing, typography, components and responsive behavior from a developer's perspective. Practice converting real UI designs into structured web interfaces. Build projects that improve your collaboration skills between designers and developers.

courses.title: WordPress Web Development
courses.description: Learn how to build professional websites using WordPress without starting everything from scratch. Understand themes, plugins, pages, menus, customization and essential WordPress settings. Build responsive business websites and manage their content effectively. Develop practical skills that can be used for freelance and client-based WordPress projects.

courses.title: WordPress Elementor Masterclass
courses.description: Master Elementor and learn how to create modern WordPress websites using a visual page builder. Build responsive layouts, landing pages, business pages and reusable sections without complex coding. Learn Elementor widgets, containers, responsive controls and customization techniques. Complete practical website projects suitable for real clients and portfolios.

courses.title: WordPress Freelancing Course
courses.description: Learn WordPress development along with the practical skills required to start freelance projects. Build professional websites, customize themes and plugins, and understand common client requirements. Learn how to organize projects and deliver websites professionally to clients. Develop a portfolio of practical projects that can help you start your freelancing journey.

courses.title: Job Ready Web Developer
courses.description: Follow a complete job-focused roadmap designed to take you from web development basics to professional skills. Learn frontend, backend, databases, APIs, Git, authentication and deployment through practical projects. Build multiple real-world applications that demonstrate your technical abilities. Prepare for interviews, portfolio development and your first professional web development role.

courses.title: Frontend Developer Career Track
courses.description: Follow a structured frontend development career path from HTML and CSS to JavaScript and React. Build a strong foundation in responsive design, modern JavaScript, reusable components and API integration. Complete practical projects using the tools and techniques used by professional developers. Develop a job-ready portfolio and gain confidence for frontend developer opportunities.
